Doing business as: Cisco Seaport
85 Northern Ave., Boston, MA 02210

Has applied for a 19H (Wines, Malts, Distillery) Pouring License to be exercised on the above The
premises to be licensed under G.L. c. 138 § 19H is an outdoor patio located at 85 Northern Ave, Boston,
MA 02210, commonly known as Block G of Seaport Square, in Boston’s seaport. Located on the licensed
premises is a farmer brewery, a farmer winery, and a farmer distillery. Cisco Brewers, Distillers, Vintners,
Seaport, Inc. manufactures beer, vints wine, and distills spirits, and is owned by the exact same five
individuals, as set forth in the §19H application. There are three pouring stations on the §19H premises
where beer, wine and spirits will be sold. There is also a retail sales to go booth which sells take out
products and merchandise. Also on the premises is a stage for live music, a bathroom station, an office
and an ID/security hut. The licensed premises begins at the corner of Seaport Boulevard and Pier 4
Boulevard, heads northward, then northeast towards the northeastern corner of the parcel, then heading
south along Northern Avenue until the corner of Northern Avenue and Pier 4 Boulevard, then back to the
corner of Seaport Boulevard and Pier 4 Boulevard. The patio will operate seasonally, and for the year
2022, the patio will be operated from April through November. The property, which is located at 85
Northern Ave, Boston, MA 02210, commonly known as Block G of Seaport Square, in Boston’s seaport,
is private property which is leased by the applicant. A copy of the lease has been attached to this
application. The total square footage of the premises is 20,360 square feet, with a seating capacity of 66
